stations.title: Noor
stations.say: Do we have oat milk, rye and eggs?

stations.title: Pip
stations.text: Asks for three scans in one reply.
stations.note: They do not depend on each other.

captions: On busy mornings Noor asks Pip about three products at once.
Pip asks for three scans together, but they run one after another.
You write the runner that starts them together, in three tasks.
Now the three scans run at the same time.
Same answer, a shorter wait. Every result still lands in order.
